consequence.statement: Only the documentation build tooling under /hack/api-docs changes; the deployed external-secrets components and their configuration are unaffected.

assertion.statement: The external-secrets 0.16.0 release bumps the mkdocs-material dependency used for the API docs tooling under /hack/api-docs from 9.6.10 to 9.6.11.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: mkdocs-material is a documentation build dependency under /hack/api-docs; no customer-environment configuration (helm values, cli flags, env vars, manifests) carries it, so no exposure predicate can be written and it is not a runtime-behaviour condition
